milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The player must navigate from spawn (~12.7 blocks away) to within 5 blocks of the potted blue orchid at spawn-relative (9, 1, 9) inside the oak plank structure, and face toward it (±60°). max_distance=5 ensures genuine navigation rather than just looking from spawn. facing_tolerance=60 confirms visual identification of the target.
